results.snippet: U.C. Berkeley’s California Memorial Stadium was built as a memorial to fallen heroes of World War I from California and stands as one of the most picturesque venues for college football. Originally constructed in 1923 and designed by the renowned architect John Galen Howard, Memorial Stadium sits directly over the Hayward Fault.
